o: Recall the essential ideas of hexadecimal.
c: Hexadecimal digits are 0–9 and A–F, where A=10 through F=15.
One hexadecimal digit represents exactly four binary bits (one nibble).
Split an eight-bit value into two four-bit groups and convert each group to one hex digit.
Multiply each hex digit by its positional value, 16 and 1, then add the results.
